question: How many of each species are there? Show it as a bar chart.
sql:
SELECT
  "species",
  COUNT(*) AS "count"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    *
  FROM penguins_csv
) AS "deduped"
GROUP BY
  "species"
ORDER BY
  "count" DESC
spec:
$schema: https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v5.json
config:
  axis:
    grid: false
  numberFormat: ',~r'
  view:
    stroke: null
height: container
layer:
- encoding:
    color:
      condition:
        test: datum.species === 'Adelie'
        value: '#1f77b4'
      value: '#aec7e8'
    tooltip:
    - field: species
      title: Species
      type: nominal
    - field: count
      title: Count
      type: quantitative
    x:
      axis:
        title: null
      field: species
      sort:
        field: count
        op: sum
        order: descending
      type: nominal
    y:
      axis:
        format: ',~r'
        tickMinStep: 1
        title: null
      field: count
      type: quantitative
  mark: bar
- encoding:
    text:
      field: count
      type: quantitative
    x:
      field: species
      sort:
        field: count
        op: sum
        order: descending
      type: nominal
    y:
      field: count
      type: quantitative
  mark:
    dy: -8
    fontSize: 13
    type: text
title:
  subtitle: 152 Adelie vs 68 Chinstrap, more than double
  text: Adelie Most Common Species
width: container
